data.string: Use @Image1 only for the creator identity, face, hair, wardrobe, room, and natural skin texture. Use @Image2 only for the product silhouette, muted-olive finish, charcoal lid, and proportions. Do not transfer the product image background. Product: {{ product }}. Create one continuous 15-second vertical 9:16 front-camera phone testimonial. Preserve fine facial asymmetry, small spontaneous blinks, tiny gaze corrections, breathing, imperfect handheld movement, slight autofocus and exposure breathing, and mild phone compression. [0.0-4.5s] Chest-up creator alone. No product or hands visible. She begins the exact dialogue below with mild surprise. [4.5-7.0s] Without cutting away from her face, she briefly lifts the @Image2 product from below frame into the lower-right corner, never blocking her face, then lowers it completely out of frame at 7.0s. [7.0-15.0s] Keep the camera on her face with the product and hands fully out of frame through the final smile. Exact dialogue: {{ script }} No extra words. Generate picture, voice, and lip-sync together in one pass. Natural adult female voice, clear conversational English, warm mid-register, unstaged creator cadence, subtle room tone. No music, voice-over, extra speakers, subtitles, on-screen text, logos, jump cuts, cutaways, beauty-filter skin, waxy texture, rigid posture, repetitive mouth motion, exaggerated expressions, product before 4.5s, product after 7.0s, product morphing, or compositing seams.
